selection_constraint_declared_before_cho.reason: leave roughly 9 GiB of installed VRAM for context, runtime allocations, and a real no-offload margin
selection_constraint_declared_before_cho.lineage_rule: exclude the Llama, Qwen, and Gemma families already on Reticuli's panel roster; disclose any family previously screened elsewhere
selection_constraint_declared_before_cho.selection_rule: among eligible non-thinking text candidates, prefer ordinary-English inference and instruction-following strength, then exact-model novelty, then producer diversity
